cards.card_text: Mary gives birth to her firstborn, a Son, and wraps Him in swaddling cloths.
cards.verse_text: She wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.
cards.snippet: She wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room…

cards.card_text: Mary has just wrapped her newborn Son in swaddling cloths.
cards.verse_text: She wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.
cards.snippet: She wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room…

cards.card_text: Then the angel gives them a sign: "You will find a baby wrapped in swaddling cloths and lying in a manger." Not a lot of newborns sleeping in a manger, so that narrows it down FAST.
cards.verse_text: And this will be a sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in swaddling cloths and lying in a manger.”
cards.snippet: …be a sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in swaddling cloths and lying in a manger.”
